submission.justification: Crystal-K1 gives the best resolution in the 2025 summary (2.9% at 5 cm), but its assayed intrinsic background is 2.0 counts/kg/day, four times the 0.5 hard limit, so it is excluded. Of the two remaining candidates, K2 has a much better resolution than K3 at every thickness tested (best 4.32% FWHM at 5 cm versus 8.45% for K3). K2's background of 0.30 +/- 0.05 counts/kg/day is within budget. A thickness scan for K2 (2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 10 cm) gave 5.16, 5.01, 4.70, 4.32, 4.71, 6.38 % FWHM, so 5 cm is the optimum in the allowed range.

requirements.requirement: Crystal must be one of the three candidates in candidate_specs.md
Intrinsic background (100-3000 keV) must not exceed 0.5 counts/kg/day (hard)
requirements.evidence: query_assay: Crystal-K2 = 0.30 +/- 0.05 counts/kg/day (K1 = 2.0 fails; K3 = 0.10 passes).

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 662 keV
requirements.evidence: Among background-compliant options, K2 at 5 cm gives 4.32% FWHM, the best of the scan (K3 best 8.45% at 5 cm). K1 would be better (~2.9% nominal) but is excluded by the background constraint.
